item.title: Namibia Careers Expo set for March
item.description: The 15th Namibia Careers Expo is set to take place in Windhoek in March. item.title: Bank Windhoek first to accept deposits of new banknotes
item.description: Bank Windhoek has become the first bank in Namibia to upgrade its ATMs to accept deposits of the new Namibia Dollar banknotes. This is a step forward in supporting the country’s ongoing currency modernisation efforts. item.title: ACC arrests police officer and inmate on bribery charges at Ondangwa
item.description: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has arrested an inmate and a police officer at Ondangwa in connection with an alleged bribery incident dating back to 2023.
